t: This is the Fashion and Textile Museum, a building designed by the Mexican architect Ricardo Legorreta, who was known for houses, public buildings and master plans in Mexico, the United States and elsewhere. The museum itself was founded in 2003 by Zandra Rhodes. She is an English fashion and textile designer, made a Dame, whose career grew out of creating textile prints. Her designs have dressed Diana, Princess of Wales, and rock stars such as Freddie Mercury and Marc Bolan. She has also put her prints onto furniture and homewares.
